_meta.description: Historical registry of spoken lines from previously uploaded videos to prevent thought repetition across runs.

past_thoughts: Your brain is actually making up your blind spots right now.
Every single mirror you have ever looked into was brand new.
We are currently living in the exact future our past selves feared.
Naptime as a child felt like punishment, but as an adult, it feels like victory.
Your stomach doesn't know you are being tickled, so it reacts the same.
Your tongue is completely trapped inside a dark cage your whole life.
The alarm clock is the only device you set hoping it fails.
Your alarm screams at you because you set a trap for yourself.
We rehearse arguments in the shower that will literally never happen.
You are currently the oldest you've ever been and the youngest you'll ever be.
You are now manually breathing and blinking.
Your bones are wet right now and you will never see them dry.
If you replace every part of an axe, is it still the exact same axe?
You have never actually seen your own face, only reflections, screens, and photographs.
Sleeping is just charging your biological battery while dreaming is running a diagnostics test.
Your shadow is proof that light traveled ninety-three million miles to be blocked by you.
Earth is a spaceship traveling at sixty-seven thousand miles per hour.
You've survived one hundred percent of your worst days so far.
The brain named itself, recognized itself, and is now questioning that exact fact.
Every book you've ever read is just twenty-six letters rearranged.
You can't hum while holding your nose closed.
Your future self is watching you right now through your memories.
Lighter was invented before the matchstick.
You can't create a new color in your mind no matter how hard you try.
Water isn't wet by itself, it only makes other things wet.
You are always seeing your nose, your brain just chooses to ignore it.
